summary: Qwen3-TTS open text-to-speech family (0.6B/1.7B, 12Hz tokenizer) with voice design and cloning, released on Hugging Face and the Qwen API.
Qwen3-ASR multilingual speech-recognition models (0.6B and 1.7B) released with a forced aligner for transcription and language ID.
Qwen3-Coder-Next, a repository-level agentic coding model, released as open weights and later added to Model Studio.
Qwen3.5-Plus, the first API tier of the Qwen3.5 native vision-language series, launched in Model Studio ahead of the open-weight release.
Qwen3.5 flagship open-weight release (397B total / 17B active MoE) with a unified vision-language foundation and gated delta-net hybrid attention.
Qwen3.5-Flash, the latency-optimised vision-language tier of Qwen3.5, released on Model Studio.
Mid-size Qwen3.5 open weights (122B-A10B MoE, 35B-A3B MoE and 27B dense), all native vision-language models.
Small Qwen3.5 open checkpoints (9B, 4B, 2B, 0.8B) for local and edge deployment.
Qwen-Image-2.0 unified image generation and editing model with 1k-token prompts and improved text rendering.
Qwen3.5-Omni (Plus, Flash and realtime variants) adds 10+ hour audio understanding and 400s of 720p audio-visual dialogue with speech output in 30+ languages.
Qwen3.6-Plus, the vision-language Plus tier of Qwen3.6, with large gains in agentic coding, front-end work and visual localisation.
Wan2.7 video generation family (text-, image- and reference-to-video plus video editing) with improved motion and cinematic cuts.
Text-only preview of Qwen3.6-Max with stronger vibe coding, coding-agent execution and front-end generation.
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B open hybrid-attention MoE with improved agentic coding, STEM reasoning and spatial vision.
Qwen3.6-Flash, a faster vision-language tier optimised for agentic coding and code reasoning.
Qwen3.6-27B dense vision-language model delivering flagship-level coding in a 27B checkpoint.
Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro, the quality tier of the 2.0 image family, with stronger text rendering and photoreal textures.
Qwen3.7-Max preview, a text-only thinking-mode flagship aimed at agent-centric coding and long-horizon autonomy.
General availability of Qwen3.7-Max, the 1M-context flagship for agentic coding and office work.
Qwen3.7-Plus adds vision-language understanding and GUI interaction to the cost-efficient Qwen3.7 tier.
June snapshot of Qwen3.7-Max adding visual understanding for multimodal interactive agents.
Qwen-Audio-3.0 TTS Plus and Flash speech synthesis models with dialect support and fine-grained emotional control.
Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro generates dense, newspaper-style layouts with 10px text in 12 languages and 20+ fonts.
Qwen3.7-Flash upgrades multimodal perception, spatial intelligence and multimodal agent execution over 3.6-Flash.
Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Flash (streaming, file and batch variants) adds seven Chinese dialect groups and 30 languages.
Multilingual Qwen3.7 text embedding model with 256-2560 configurable dimensions and 20% MTEB gains over text-embedding-v4.
Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4T-parameter MoE flagship with native vision, 1M context and multi-day autonomous coding; open weights followed ten days later.
Qwen-Image-3.0 standard tier for high-volume poster, web-page and infographic generation.
Wan3.0 all-in-one video model supporting reference, editing, replication and driving with up to 30-second output.
Qwen-Audio-3.0 realtime duplex speech models (Plus and Flash) ranked first on Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech at launch.
First open release of a Qwen-Max-class model: 2.4T total / 95B active MoE with 1M context, GPQA Diamond 92.6 and OSWorld 86.1.
Qwen3.8-27B dense vision-language checkpoint bringing Qwen3.8 coding and office skills to a laptop-class model.
High-speed variant of Wan3.0-Video with the same reference-input capability and up to 30-second clips.
Open-weight follow-up to Qwen3.8-Flash published on Hugging Face as Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.
Qwen3.8-Flash, a multimodal 1M-context speed tier for coding agents and desktop automation, claimed to cut training costs.
September snapshot of Qwen3.8-Max with stronger engineering-scale coding, multi-tool orchestration and refined vision.
Qwen-Image-2.1 compact 7B image generation and editing model with native transparency support.
Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash accepts text, image, audio and video input with thinking/non-thinking modes and web search.
Cost-optimised Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo with transparent-image generation and multi-reference editing.
